Hi Nora / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Great to hear about the POC goals and the need to run inference for patient-summary generation inside your VPC (data residency + auditability are top priorities). A quick recap from my side: 

- Primary goal: host an on-prem/private Redwood runtime behind your VPC for telemetry control and SOC-2 alignment.
- Initial throughput target: ~150 concurrent requests (95th percentile SLA target: 250ms per request for 512-token prompts).
- Security needs: customer-managed KMS, audit logs surfaced to your SIEM, and support for private subnets.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra + security team to validate network requirements, KMS integration, and sizing.
2) Review of a proposed minimal-viable architecture (we'll bring a reference diagram).
3) Book a short pilot scoping session to align milestones and success criteria.

Can you both make time for a 60-minute technical architecture review next week? Here are times that work on my end (PT):
- Mon 5/18 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00 PT
- Tue 5/19 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed 5/20 11:00–12:00 PT

I've attached a short one-pager and a starter architecture diagram that we can use as a baseline. If none of those slots work, drop a few windows and I will loop in Evelyn (our solutions engineer) to join.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
